source: Carbacid Investments Plc audited consolidated results for the year ended 31 July 2026, KES. Revenue and net profit as published in the abridged results (NSE announcement, 4 November 2026); gross profit, finance costs, tax charge, EPS, total assets 7.16bn and shareholders equity 5.76bn from the FY2026 annual report summary. Operating profit is derived as profit before tax plus net finance costs, cost of sales as revenue less gross profit, and margins and returns recomputed from those inputs. Operating profit for FY2025 to FY2022 is recomputed as profit before tax plus net finance costs, which reproduces the 1,356 million the issuer printed for FY2025; the previous EBIT row carried a segment operating result that excluded other income and revaluation gains. CRON 20261110_0254: Cost of Sales and Gross Profit added for the annual periods FY2025, FY2024, FY2023, FY2022 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income series, where the source group total for gross profit ties to revenue less cost of sales; cost of sales is stored as a positive magnitude and the source prints it negative.
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks.
